entities.name: Epityr
entities.description: Mountain-town in eastern Terisiare famous for its Temple of Serra, part of New Argive.

entities.name: Darien's Roost
entities.description: Small mountain town founded during peacemaking between Kjeldor and Balduvia; grew into Epityr.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Land whose descendants Epityr was dedicated to.

entities.name: Balduvia
entities.description: Land with which Kjeldor made peace.

entities.name: Edgur of Epityr
entities.description: Descendant of the founders of the first Epityr, reduced to a merchant.

entities.name: Sheoltun
entities.description: Occupiers who forced Epityr to adopt their culture.

entities.name: Thabit of Almaaz
entities.description: Songwizard who started the Uprising in Epityr.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Angel whose Serra Angels aided the rebellion and whose statues Norn defiled.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Praetor who defiled Epityr's statues of Serra.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Epityr was targeted.

events.summary: During the Sheoltun Occupation, Thabit of Almaaz starts the Uprising in Epityr with Serra Angels.
events.quote: started the Uprising in Epityr by bringing forth Serra Angels

events.summary: Elesh Norn defiles Epityr's statues of Serra during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Epityr was targeted by Elesh Norn
